create.name: Dr. Lotte Valentin
create.bio:
Dr. Lotte Valentin grew up in Sweden in a family of doctors and nurses, emigrated to the United States and spent years in corporate work before two near-death experiences ended her atheism and set her searching through religion, science and spiritual teaching for an explanation. She went on to train in mediumship and trance work at Arthur Findlay College in England and to study shamanism with Itzhak Beery, and at fifty-four she entered medical school, qualifying in naturopathic medicine in 2016.

Her spiritual work centres on mediumship and on Kindraya, a method of ancestral healing she developed that uses shamanic journeying to explore patterns handed down through a family line. She offers one-to-one sessions online, from evidential mediumship readings and messages from spirit guides to longer spiritual mentoring, and teaches through live workshops, recorded courses on her School of Divine Spiritual Essence, and guided meditation journeys made with Hemi-Sync. She hosts the podcast Dr. Lotte: Science with Soul, which includes a conversational series, Between Us, with her daughter Lilith, and she has taught online courses for The Shift Network.

courses.title: When the Past Shows Up at the Holiday Table: A Journey into Ancestral Relationship Healing
courses.description: A two-hour live online workshop on how patterns carried through a family line can surface in holiday gatherings, ending with a guided Kindraya ancestral journey. A replay is available for a week afterwards.
courses.price: $99 USD ($79 USD early bird until 15 November)

courses.title: Kindraya® Ancestral Healing Practitioner Training
courses.description: An immersive training for people who want to practise her Kindraya method of ancestral work with others. It opens in spring 2027; for now there is a waitlist.

courses.title: Evidential Mediumship Reading
courses.description: A thirty-minute online session aimed at making contact with a particular person who has died, with the focus on evidence of their continued presence rather than on predictions.

courses.title: Messages From Your Spirit Guides
courses.description: A thirty-minute session in which she relays guidance from the client's spirit guides, with an optional sketch of a guide sent afterwards by email.

courses.title: Spiritual Guidance & Mentorship
courses.description: An hour-long one-to-one session for people who want support and direction on their own spiritual path, covering practice, consciousness and personal questions.

courses.title: Connecting with Your Spirit Team
courses.description: A recorded course in eight modules on building a relationship with spirit animals, guides and loved ones in spirit, using guided meditations and exercises. Access lasts two years.

courses.title: Indra's Net Guided Meditation
courses.description: A thirty-minute guided meditation journey made with Hemi-Sync, built around the image of a web of light that links all beings.

courses.title: Mother Moon Guided Meditation
courses.description: A fourteen-minute guided journey made with Hemi-Sync, set in a night-time forest under the moon, for rest and a sense of connection.

Borderline on the medical rule, human please check: she is a naturopathic doctor and her site also sells Medical Intuitive & Wellness sessions, supplements and at-home tests, and her about page lists post-graduate certificates in mould, hormones and similar. Her session menu, courses, meditations and podcast are mostly spiritual (mediumship, spirit guides, ancestral work), so I listed her with every medical item left out.

Her YouTube channel is her podcast: mostly spirituality, but a minority of episodes are condition-led (MCAS, hypermobility, anxiety and breath, blindness to healing); not 'mainly' condition-led, so not skipped, but none of those were taken.
Email is her assistant's Gmail address (dr.lotte.assistant@gmail.com), published on her contact page for all enquiries; her daughter Lilith is the assistant.

Kindraya is framed on her site around generational trauma; I kept only the practitioner training (page has no condition wording) and the December workshop (relationship patterns), and left the Kindraya session and Mother Wound course out (see left_out).
Name kept as 'Dr. Lotte Valentin' because she is publicly known as Dr. Lotte; post-nominal NMD dropped.
Many YouTube titles appear auto-translated into Portuguese on the channel page; the English titles used are from oEmbed.
